_comment: Real executed case results. Only IDs whose acceptance oracle genuinely ran may appear here. Absence means NOT_RUN_BLOCKED_MATERIAL, never PASS.

results.reason: EXECUTED. Two release builds of the same revision produced non-identical artifacts (MSI D28C0B94->33D28A7E, NSIS 6D9B45A4->DC271F29, exe 6E09A3DD->6F223D7D). Root cause fully measured: (1) WiX regenerates MSI ProductCode per build (UpgradeCode stable); (2) binary differs by exactly 19 bytes, all PE TimeDateStamp + CodeView RSDS GUID/age metadata. Differences are explained but NOT eliminated (no [profile.release] config exists) and NOT verified across two clean environments as SUP-004 step 1 requires. Not PASS.

EXECUTED for the built formats. MSI and NSIS both produced (exit 0), digests pinned, product identity independently read back via the Windows Installer COM API (ProductName=LINCHPIN, ProductVersion=0.1.0, valid GUIDs), magic bytes confirmed (MSI D0CF11E0 OLE, exes MZ/PE). NOT PASS: artifacts are unsigned (PF-015, no signing identity), there is no SBOM/notices/provenance artifact, no prohibited-content scan has been run over installer contents, and no install/uninstall exercise has been performed.
